title: Automated Greenhouse Monitor
tagline: Keep your monster botanical garden thriving with soil moisture telemetry and automated relay irrigation!

phases.instructions: Locate from your kit: Arduino Uno, Soil Moisture Sensor (comp_26), 5V Relay Module (comp_36), DHT11 Temp/Humidity (comp_09), 1602 I2C LCD (comp_07), Piezo Buzzer (comp_34), Breadboard, and jumper wires.
verificationCheckpoints: Soil moisture dual-probe clean and dry

phases.instructions: Connect Soil Probe A0 to Arduino A0. Connect DHT11 DATA to Pin 2. Connect 5V Relay IN to Pin 7. Connect LCD SDA/SCL to A4/A5. Connect Buzzer to Pin 8.
verificationCheckpoints: Common ground shared across all modules
Relay VCC wired to 5V power rail

phases.instructions: Verify relay coil isolation. Ensure test pump is powered by a low-voltage battery pack (never wall AC).
verificationCheckpoints: No short circuits on sensor power headers

phases.instructions: Review closed-loop control: when soil moisture falls below DRY_THRESHOLD, the relay triggers the pump. When moisture exceeds MOIST_THRESHOLD, the pump turns off.
phases.codeExplanation:
- Hysteresis thresholding (700 on, 400 off) prevents rapid, damaging relay chatter.
- DHT11 reads ambient room air temperature every second.
- LCD renders real-time soil resistance and atmospheric climate telemetry.

phases.instructions: Upload the sketch. Keep probe in air to watch the relay click ON. Dip probe in a cup of water and observe the relay click OFF automatically!
verificationCheckpoints: Relay indicator LED illuminates when soil is dry
LCD updates temperature and soil values live

phases.instructions: Botany Master! Your automated greenhouse controller protects sensitive plants with precision watering.

variants.title: Solar Radiance Irrigation
variants.description: Incorporate a photoresistor (comp_19) so plants are only irrigated after sunset to reduce water evaporation.
variants.wiringDifferences: Wire photoresistor voltage divider to A1
variants.codeAdaptation: Add condition: if (moisture < THRESHOLD && lightLevel < SUNSET_LEVEL) activatePump();

extensionMissions.title: Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD) Calculator
extensionMissions.objective: Calculate and display air VPD in kiloPascals (kPa) on the LCD using DHT11 temp and humidity curves.
hints: Look up the Tetens formula for saturation vapor pressure

story: Your greenhouse plants need constant moisture and temperature management while you're away! Build an autonomous environmental controller that reads soil conductivity and turns on a 5V relay water pump with LCD telemetry.

troubleshooting.symptom: Relay chatters on and off rapidly
troubleshooting.cause: Threshold values are too close together without a hysteresis deadband
troubleshooting.solution: Widen the gap between the turn-on (700) and turn-off (400) threshold constants.
diagnosticSteps: Print raw analogRead(A0) to Serial Monitor
Ensure at least 200 units of separation between ON and OFF thresholds
